subject: Your FF Digest

disagreements.detail: High expert disagreement: rank 6-20 (std 3.13) -- highest: Mike Harmon (#5), lowest: Nathan Jahnke (#21)

news.title: Divine Deablo (forearm) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: Deablo returned to practice on Thursday. He should be on the favorable side of questionable heading into Sunday.

news.title: Billy Bowman Jr. (hamstring) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: Bowman returned to a limited practice on Thursday. He appears to be on the favorable side of questionable.

news.title: Mike Hall Jr. (ankle) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Hall is officially good to go being off the injury report heading into Sunday.

news.title: Daniel Thomas (ankle) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: Thomas was limited in practice throughout the week. He will need to be monitored closer to kickoff.

news.title: Tytus Howard (concussion) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: Howard will have till Saturday to clear concussion protocol.

narrative: Two things worth your attention this week. First, the experts can't agree on Dak Prescott — he's landing anywhere from #6 to #20 at QB, with Mike Harmon bullish at #5 while Nathan Jahnke buries him at #21. That's a standard deviation of 3.13, which is a polite way of saying nobody has a clue, so trust your own read. Second, and less ambiguous: Garrett Wilson is now listed OUT with a knee injury. Adjust your lineup accordingly.
